# Spec-owned paths: a PR that changes any of them needs the "spec-change" label.
#
# Read by .github/scripts/check-spec-label.sh (workflow: spec-label.yml).
# One bash glob per line; '*' also crosses '/', so 'design/*' covers
# design/screens/x.html. Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are skipped.
#
# Not here on purpose: docs/work-items.md (Devin updates the build columns),
# docs/analysis/ (Devin writes audit reports), docs/screenshots/ (PR evidence).

# Behaviour spec, its changelog and the map
docs/SPEC.md
docs/CHANGES.md
docs/README.md
docs/RESEARCH.md
docs/DEVIN_KICKOFF.md
docs/kickoffs/*

# Agent rules
AGENTS.md
CLAUDE.md

# Prompts (a version in use is never edited) and the env contract
backend/prompts/*
.env.example

# Look and wording
design/*

# The gate itself
.github/spec-paths.txt
.github/scripts/check-spec-label.sh
.github/workflows/spec-label.yml
